discrepancies.reference_text: दिव्या मुझे ना बहुत जरूरत है यार
discrepancies.translation_text: Yes, Divya, I need you very much, friend.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I have a great need' (general), but the translation adds 'you' ('I need you'), changing the meaning.

discrepancies.reference_text: मुझे ना बहुत जरूरत है बहुत ज्यादा जरूरत है यार
discrepancies.translation_text: I need you very much, I need you a lot, friend.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I have a great need, a very big need' (general), but the translation adds 'you' ('I need you').

discrepancies.reference_text: हां भेज देती हूं लड़की बताओ कहां भेजनी है
discrepancies.translation_text: Yes, I will send it, girl, tell me where to send it.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I will send a girl' (लड़की), but the translation translates 'लड़की' as a vocative 'girl' ('I will send it, girl').
